facts.text: Audrey has tattoos of her dogs on her arm.

evidence.quote: I know right? They mean the world to me. So much that I got tattoos of them on my arm.
I got it a while ago. It represents my love for my pups and nature's beauty.

facts.text: Audrey and Andrew are looking forward to a party where they will see their dogs together.

evidence.quote: It's gonna be awesome to see all of them together and chowing down. Super excited!
Yay! This'll be awesome! Seeing them all together, having fun and enjoying treats is the best.
This would be a good chance for you to hang out with them.
